name: Default
shortDescription: Declarative YAML workflow orchestration platform with a web UI and API, backed by PostgreSQL for flows, executions and queues.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploying: the first visit shows a Setup page where you create the admin login (a valid email address and a password of at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter and a number).
The Docker socket is not mounted, so script tasks (Python, Shell, Node and similar) must set taskRunner type io.kestra.plugin.core.runner.Process; the default Docker task runner is unavailable.
Kestra needs at least 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB of memory to run correctly.
